title: Smart Connected Pill Dispenser
description: Designed and developed a smart ESP32-based pill dispenser for automatic medication dispensing. The system integrates an LCD display, RTC module, stepper motor, buzzer, LED, and a mobile application for alarm scheduling and notifications.

title: Line-Following Robot
description: Designed and programmed a line-following robot using infrared sensors, a Raspberry Pi Pico, and control algorithms to achieve accurate and reliable path tracking.

title: Automatic Irrigation System
description: Developed an Arduino-based smart irrigation system that automatically waters plants using a soil moisture sensor and an electronically controlled water pump.
